parameters.text:
=You are a tech recruiter assistant. Classify the skills list below into EXACTLY ONE category.

Skills: {{ $json.skills_normalized }}

Keyword pre-classifier hint: "{{ $json.keywordCategory }}" (confidence {{ $json.keywordConfidence }}). Use as a hint only — make your own judgement.

Categories (pick exactly one):
- automation-heavy : n8n, Zapier, Make, RPA, CI/CD, webhooks, workflow automation
- web-dev          : React, Vue, Angular, HTML/CSS, TypeScript, JavaScript (frontend focus)
- data             : SQL, Python, pandas, ML, analytics, ETL, data science
- fullstack        : Backend + frontend combined (e.g. Django+React, Node+Vue)
- devops           : Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, GCP, Azure, Linux, cloud infra
- other            : Anything that does not clearly fit the above

Return a confidence between 0 and 1 and one short sentence of reasoning.

nodeGroups.name: ① Ingest
nodeGroups.description: Config, fetch untagged candidates, normalise skill strings, compute keyword hints, reset global result stores.

nodeGroups.name: ③ Collect & Write Primary Results
nodeGroups.description: Read primary results from store, bulk-write tagged items to API, log failures queued for the retry sweep.

nodeGroups.name: ④ Fetch Remaining Failures
nodeGroups.description: Re-fetch still-untagged candidates from API after the primary write and bundle them for the failure-count gate.

nodeGroups.name: ⑤ Rate Limit Reset + Sweep Prep
nodeGroups.description: 60 s Vertex AI quota cool-down, then expand and re-normalise failed candidates ready for the retry loop.

nodeGroups.name: ⑦ Collect & Write Sweep Results
nodeGroups.description: Read retry-sweep results from store, bulk-write newly-tagged items to API. Permanently-failed items logged for the next run.
